caption: The drawing depicts a lace or embroidery design positioned at the upper center of a vertically-oriented sheet of paper with an off-white or light beige background. The design features a large, vertically-oriented oval medallion filled with a symmetric arrangement of stylized flowers and leaves. Surrounding the oval are several small, circular floral motifs arranged in a semi-circular pattern. Extending from either side of the oval are two bands, each decorated with repeating floral and leaf motifs. Directly below the oval, a fan-shaped arrangement of floral and leaf forms extends outward, ending in a single, prominent flower at the bottom. The overall color scheme of the drawing is monochromatic, rendered in light gray pencil or chalk on the neutral background. The lower two-thirds of the paper are largely blank except for a faint handwritten word "OVER" near the bottom edge.
title: Lace Collar
